info.name: Restaurant API
info.description:
# Restaurant API

Menu, cart, checkout, orders, comments and favorites. JWT authentication.

## Quick start
1. Start the API (see the repository README) and load the sample menu: `python manage.py loaddata demo_menu`.
2. Import this collection (and optionally the environment). `base_url` defaults to `http://localhost:8000`.
3. Open the **Collection Runner** and run the collection. Folders 0 to 6 run a complete scenario: register, login, browse, cart, checkout, cancel, comments, favorites and error cases. Every request has tests.
4. Folder 7 needs a superuser; set `admin_username` and `admin_password` or deselect the folder.

## How it works
- Runtime values (`access_token`, `food_id`, `order_id`, ...) are collection variables, saved by test scripts.
- Authentication is set on the collection (`Bearer {{access_token}}`); public folders override it with *No Auth*.
- Interactive docs: `{{base_url}}/api/docs/` (Swagger UI) and `{{base_url}}/api/redoc/`.
